newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Firm but puzzling finish for S.African shares.
newsitem.headline: Firm but puzzling finish for S.African shares.

text.p: After a day of baffling trade which saw South African shares suffer earlier, shares astonished dealers by recovering in the afternoon to end firm.
"It was a strange and confusing day," a dealer said.
Shares started weak and extended losses, dragged down by falling bullion and a feeble rand.
Morning morale was low -- knocked further by worse-than-expected August trade figures released on Monday -- and when shares started to recover by lunch it took the market by surprise, dealers said.
Defying a weak rand and soft bullion price, shares were pulled up by the buying of stock at low levels and the grabbing of all-share baskets by institutions.
Gold shares also took heart from a slight improvement in the bullion price.
But overall the market was seen holding these levels.
The all-share index added 18.2 points to 6,896.2, industrials put on 3.5 points to 8,134.1 and golds were up 23.5 points to 1,677.2.
